title: config/release-assets.json
description: The release archives of other repositories that this repository uses, each pinned by its version and sha256 (scripts/kit/release-assets.mts, make release-assets-fetch). The version is declared here once; a Makefile that needs it reads it with `release-assets.mts version <name>`.

name.description: The name of the entry, unique in the file, by which a Makefile and consumers.composer.polyspec of config/release.json name it.

version.description: The release version of the archive, X.Y.Z with an optional pre-release; `{version}` of url stands for it.

url.description: The https URL of the archive; `{version}` stands for the version. Its last path segment is the file name of the destination.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the archive, 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

directory.description: The directory of the archive, under var/ of the repository, which Git ignores; the destination is this directory and the file name of url.

unpack.description: The directory under var/ into which the archive, a zip, is extracted.
